ui_assets.name: pixelboom_ui_kit
ui_assets.prompt: Pixel art UI kit for a cute cartoon top-down Bomberman-style arena game. Flat cel shading with only two tones per color, thick dark outline (#14121c), bright readable palette, pale cream (#f4ecd8) borders and faces with a darker plum-navy interior, warm wood-brown and bomb-black accents. Crisp straight edges, readable at very small size. No gradient, no texture, no glow, no sparkles, no text, no icons inside the shapes. Pieces: a large empty dialog panel with a thick cream frame and dark interior; a wide chunky empty button with a cream face and dark outline and a 2px darker bottom lip; a small empty square slot; a round empty player badge; a wide horizontal empty banner ribbon for round results; a small downward-pointing chunky triangular arrow marker in cream white.
